geographicInspection: Separate static geographic plots inspected against Natural Earth coastline and reused settlement controls; all seven traces in their intended theatres. Source23 northern Finnish segment excluded from the German trace. Not a browser/MapLibre interaction test.

registrationDiagnostics.method: Least-squares affine registration from source-image x,y pixels to Web Mercator settlement coordinates, then inverse projection to WGS84 longitude,latitude. This is a display-coordinate registration, not an assertion about the source projection. No rubber-sheeting.

limitations: No occupied-area polygons inferred from front lines.
January 19 and February 18, 1943 retain detailed source-map coverage but no new geographic military tracing; the older whole-front synthesis mixes earlier dates and is not copied.
Nine composite-sheet formation labels are earlier source-interval references only, not per-day deployment positions; other ambiguous labels are not mapped.
Crimea arrows are a completed operation overview, not daily positions.
Finland trace covers the Karelian Isthmus only; northern Karelia remains available on the original source map.
The Kiev inset on sheet16 has its own scale and is not transformed by the main-sheet registration.
Other printed source maps retain full detail in the interactive source-image viewer; they have not all been georeferenced.
